WolvenKitAccent: Main accent: selected tabs, focused fields, primary buttons, checked toggles
WolvenKitAccentShadow: Darker accent: hovered tabs and buttons
WolvenKitAccentForeground: Text and icons on accent-colored surfaces (selected tabs, primary buttons)
WolvenKitAccentShadowForeground: Text on hovered tabs (on the accent shadow color)
WolvenKitStatusBarReady: Status bar background when WolvenKit is idle
WolvenKitStatusBarBusy: Status bar background while a task is running
ContentBackground: Base background of panels, documents and dialogs
ContentBackgroundAlt: Slightly raised surfaces: home page cards, vector editors, import/export lists
ContentBackgroundAlt2: Main window frame, panel headers, docking area, input areas
ContentBackgroundAlt3: Secondary surfaces: dialogs, docking tabs, LocKey browser, graph palette
ContentBackgroundAlt4: Hover/pressed surfaces: docking tabs, ribbon, home page
ContentBackgroundAlt5: Strongest raised surface: ribbon, import/export headers
ContentForegroundAlt1: Secondary text inside Syncfusion controls (grids, docking, menus)
BorderAlt: Borders of fields and frames in property editors, documents and dialogs
WolvenKitPanelHeaderSelected: Header of the active docked panel; hovered panel headers
WolvenKitPanelHeaderSelectedForeground: Text on the active panel header
WolvenKitPanelTabSelected: Selected tab in docked panel tab groups
WolvenKitPanelCardHover: Hovered project card on the welcome page
WolvenKitPanelProgressTrack: Track of the progress bar in the status bar
WolvenKitGray12Color: Darkest gray: document menu bar, properties panel, tree buttons
WolvenKitGray12: Darkest gray: document menu bar, properties panel, tree buttons
WolvenKitGray1E: Graph view and section timeline backgrounds
WolvenKitGray25: Backgrounds in tool dialogs (photo mode app, component properties, materials, checklists)
WolvenKitGray31: Document view background and selected document tabs
WolvenKitGray37: Borders and surfaces in the type template manager and script manager
WolvenKitGray40: Toolbars and panels in quest, scene and behavior graph editors
WolvenKitGray7F: Connection lines and handles in graph editors
WolvenKitGray99: Secondary text in graph views and on the welcome page
WolvenKitGray66: Placeholder / empty-value text in reference, CName, tweak and path fields
WolvenKitGrayDD: Not used by WolvenKit views at the moment
WolvenKitGray33: Not used by WolvenKit views at the moment
WolvenKitGrayCC: Light secondary text on the welcome page and in the Project Explorer
WolvenKitGray88: Node text in the graph editor
WolvenKitGray77: Dimmed node text in the graph editor
WolvenKitProjectSource: Project Explorer: "source" tab and folder highlight
WolvenKitProjectResources: Project Explorer: "resources" tab and folder highlight
PrimaryColor: HandyControl accent (search bars, some text boxes); follows the main accent unless set
RegionColor: HandyControl panel background (search bars, side panels)
BackgroundColor: HandyControl window background; also graph comment and mesh preview backgrounds
BorderColor: HandyControl borders; also many borders in WolvenKit views
PrimaryTextColor: HandyControl main text (popups, scene and dialogue dialogs)
ForegroundColor: Default text color of WolvenKit's own styles (labels, dialogs)
ForegroundColor_Grey_Light: Light secondary text: hovered links and labels
ForegroundColor_Grey1: Secondary text: property names and hints in the property tree
ForegroundColor_Grey_Dark: Dim text: inactive labels, loading messages, descriptions
BackgroundColor_Control: Background of input controls: text boxes, dropdowns, checkboxes, filter fields
BackgroundColor_Frame_Active: Background of the active / focused frame (editor windows, CName fields)
BackgroundColor_Frame_Background: Background of dialog frames and the document menu bar
BackgroundColor_Button_Active: Background of active buttons in WolvenKit dialogs
WolvenKitRedColor: Delete / stop / remove icons, errors, hovered tabs in graph editors
WolvenKitGreenColor: Play / run / add icons, success messages, connections in quest and scene graphs
WolvenKitGreenShadowColor: Darker green (not used by WolvenKit views at the moment)
WolvenKitCyanColor: Save / new tab / cache icons, values and links in editors, connections in data graphs
WolvenKitCyanShadowColor: Darker cyan: hovered Project Explorer buttons
WolvenKitYellowColor: New file / add icons, warnings, highlighted fields and hovered items in graph editors
WolvenKitYellowShadowColor: Darker yellow: hovered Project Explorer buttons
WolvenKitPurpleColor: Refresh / sync / archive icons in menus, ribbon, settings and plugins
WolvenKitDarkPinkColor: Not used by WolvenKit views at the moment
WolvenKitTanColor: Folder icons, resource paths and references in the property tree

WolvenKitOrangeShadowColor: Hovered "copy path" button in the Project Explorer

WolvenKitYellowShadow25Color: Faint translucent yellow background: unresolved reference / CName fields
